summary: Defines an SMIv2 Management Information Base module for Reliable Server Pooling. The framework has two protocols, ASAP and ENRP, and this MIB lets administrators monitor them. It is an Experimental document.

eli5.summary: A group of backup servers should stay healthy. This note defines the gauges used to check on them, so administrators can see how the pool is doing.

questions: how to monitor reliable server pooling
